## Unity Project Instructions

This is a Unity game development project. When working with this codebase:

- Use Unity-specific C# conventions and patterns
- All game scripts should inherit from MonoBehaviour when appropriate
- Use Unity's component-based architecture
- Follow Unity naming conventions (PascalCase for public members, camelCase for private)
- Use Unity's built-in functions (Start, Update, FixedUpdate, etc.)
- Prefer Unity's API over standard .NET when available
- Test changes in Unity Editor before committing
- Keep scripts focused and single-purpose following SOLID principles
